publication.citation: Fu, X., Vijayakumar, G., Lee, B., and Sprague, M. (2026), Numerical simulation of vortex-induced vibration response of a single IEA 10-MW wind turbine blade, Journal of Fluids and Structures 143, 104537

digitization.method: Circle centers were recovered from the PDF vector paths and calibrated against each panel's vector axis ticks; no raster point picking was used.
digitization.source_status: vector-digitized estimates, not author-provided raw solver values
digitization.separate_numerical_uncertainty_note: Fu et al. report approximately 5 to 10 percent mesh variation for strongly responding cases; this is separate from digitization uncertainty.

frequency_scoring_rule.reason: Below this preregistered signal threshold, a dominant spectral peak is not treated as a robust comparison observable.

public_iea_model.published_structural_note: Fu et al. report 73 BeamDyn quadrature nodes; the paper does not provide the exact node spacing or pin the complete ExaWind case revision.

recreation_boundary.exact_boundary_reason: The current QBlade example uses a reduced HAWC2 set-1 Timoshenko structure and single-mode damping approximation, while raw Fu CFD force histories and the cited complete ExaWind case are unavailable.
recreation_boundary.one_case_boundary: The existing P100-I50, U=18 m/s QBlade input maps to Fu P80A310, U=18 m/s; this is an input/configuration match, not an exact Fu aerodynamic or structural recreation.
recreation_boundary.analogue_boundary: All four documented angle configurations and five wind speeds can be represented as QBlade kinematic/structural analogues after explicit parameterization and coordinate re-audit.

debug_prohibited_uses: structural-property tuning to the Fu target
preregistration.terminology: locked holdout from fitting; not strictly blind because target values are public and included in this package
preregistration.freeze_rule: No response-model coefficient, structural property, force scale, or scoring rule may change after the debug audit if the 19 cases are to remain holdouts.

scope.no_del_reason: Figure 21 provides tip response summaries only; it does not provide load or response time histories needed for rainflow counting or DEL calculation.
